propositions: The standing eval completion-verifier constructs a single PydanticAIRunner before disposable case fixtures exist, causing filesystem and ticket tools to read the checkout root instead of per-case fixture repos
Runner._effective_config substitutes only per-request model tuning and preserves the base repo_path, so injected live runners retain the eval checkout path across all cases
Targeted completion cases (CV-complete-feature, CV-complete-bugfix, CV-complete-refactor) failed because they could not access fixture files such as src/cli.py and app/profile.py in the wrong root
The fix re-roots the injected runner at each disposable case store via eval_solver._rerooted and clears tickets_path to read fixture-local stores
After the fix, the full live completion-verifier standing eval passes all 11 cases across 3 epochs with coverage 1.0 and epoch_pass=[True, True, True]
